claims: Amen Corner is the three-hole stretch consisting of holes 11, 12, and 13 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Herbert Warren Wind coined the term Amen Corner in 1958.
Amen Corner's Hole 11 is named White Dogwood.
Amen Corner's Hole 11 is a 520-yard par-4.
A pond guards the left side of the green on Amen Corner's Hole 11.
Amen Corner's Hole 12 is named Golden Bell.
Amen Corner's Hole 12 is a 155-yard par-3 over Rae's Creek to a shallow green.
Amen Corner's Hole 13 is named Azalea.
Amen Corner's Hole 13 is a par-5 with a creek snaking in front of the green.
Amen Corner is the site of Rory McIlroy's collapse in 2011.
Amen Corner is the site of Jordan Spieth's collapse in 2016.
Sports Illustrated writer Herbert Warren Wind named Amen Corner in 1958.
Herbert Warren Wind was inspired by the jazz tune "Shouting in That Amen Corner" when naming Amen Corner.
